explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 60 configurations over 14 sweeps (topology, ep-off, pipeline, moe-collective, kv-capacity, batch-caps, routing-prefix-cache, prefill-chunking, pd-ratio, pd-always, pd-wide-decode, pd-pool-engine, pd-decode-cudagraph, cudagraph), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 64 GPUs.

2x TP8xPP4 + EP, from the pipeline sweep, reached 32.11 tok/s/accelerator (2055.3 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 128 while holding the scenario's SLOs. 228 runs were refused and are not counted as misses: 47 configurations (188 runs): scenario: kernelmodel: muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-nvfp4 does not fit 79.2 GiB devices at tp=8 (expert-parallel width 8): one rank's weights alone are 80.8 GiB, and its fixed occupancy 83.1 GiB; widen tensor or expert parallelism or use a larger part. No KV budget exists; 6 configurations (24 runs): scenario: kernelmodel: muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-nvfp4 does not fit 79.2 GiB devices at tp=8 (expert-parallel width 8): one rank's weights alone are 80.8 GiB, and its fixed occupancy 84.4 GiB; widen tensor or expert parallelism or use a larger part. No KV budget exists; 2 configurations (8 runs): scenario: kernelmodel: muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-nvfp4 does not fit 79.2 GiB devices at tp=8 (expert-parallel width 8): one rank's weights alone are 80.8 GiB, and its fixed occupancy 82.5 GiB; widen tensor or expert parallelism or use a larger part. No KV budget exists; 2 more reasons. Ranking: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs.
2x TP8xPP4 + EP at concurrency 128. 9 of 240 runs held the SLOs.
